title: Animation libraries driven by renderAt
objective: Show GSAP, anime.js and Lottie seeked frame by frame by make_video.py.

beats.say: A GSAP timeline moves the box to the right.
Then it turns and changes color.
An anime.js timeline lifts the first bar.
Then the second bar grows higher.
A Lottie animation moves the square across.
Its second segment spins the square.
